desc:
🐾 Welcome to Animal Hospital! 🏥

Something's wrong with your pet, and only YOU can figure out what.

🩺 Play as a VET - treat sick animals, work your way up from Assistant to Lead Veterinarian
🐶 Play as a PET - pick your animal, pick your sickness, and act it out
🚗 Play as an OWNER - bring your pet in, carry them, speak for them, stay by their side

Nobody knows what's wrong until you tell them. Bark, whimper, cough, limp, get your owner to explain it, and let the vet work it out and book you in.

✨ Customize everything. Hair, outfits, accessories, your name, your bio.
🐕 Become an animal, be sick and get healed!
🧰 Use Thermometers, bandages, syringes, leashes, strollers, carry beds
🏗️ Build the hospital your way with props
📢 Codes, sirens, announcements, and total chaos!

👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVOURITE for free stuff

Categories: Town, Roleplay, Hospital, RP, Vet, Veterinary, Pets, Dog, Cat, Sick, Doctor, Nurse, Simulator, Adopt, Family
